## Originals and transformations

Identify immutable local originals using neutral locators, hashes, and provenance. For each derivative record input/output hashes, exact operation, tool/script/version/options, reason, redaction/normalization, and information lost. Do not imply a local-only original is downloadable from Git.

## Reproduction and interpretation

Document reproduction with authorized inputs/tools, supporting ranges, links to claim reasoning, and reproducibility limits. Original-byte checks and semantic validation are separate results.

## Integrity and storage

No raw save, imported proprietary database, executable, or bulk dump belongs here merely because it is helpful. Apply [the evidence rules](../experiments/evidence/README.md).
